confirmation_protocol.how: Run the task exactly as written below on branch v1.2, then fill in this task's john_confirmation block: set confirmed to true, confirmed_by to your name, date to the ISO YYYY-MM-DD date you ran it, and line to what you actually observed.
rules: A confirmation needs all four fields: confirmed true, a non-empty confirmed_by, an ISO YYYY-MM-DD date, and a non-empty observed line.
If a task does not reproduce as written, correct the invocation here rather than confirming it — a wrong-but-confirmed task poisons S1.
Nobody but John fills these in. An agent-authored confirmation is not evidence.
Findings-only sessions (this run) leave confirmed false so Phase-0 stays HALT until John either re-runs after fixes or deliberately signs the observed broken baseline.

tasks.title: Open real Anchor work from the dashboard
preconditions: The anchor NSSM service is running (`Get-Service anchor` reports Running).

steps: Browse to http://localhost:8777/ and hard-refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R.
Click the row for the R&D project registered against this repository to open its project window.
In the project window, click the open control on an existing effort tile (a previous planning or build effort).

tasks.expected_observable: The project window renders and the chosen effort opens with its documents reachable. If it cannot open, a NAMED cannot-open state is visible with its reason — never a dead control, never a blank pane, never a silent no-op.
failure_shapes_this_task_is_hunting: a clickable control that does nothing
a blank pane where a named state belongs
'no projects' shown when the project store could not be read

john_confirmation.line: Live Tailscale laptop after warm restart. Existing effort tiles open. Newish project (Holding Company empty git) Open terminal initially refused with named worktree HEAD error; after product fix (empty-repo seed) Open terminal works (T1 good).

john_observation_2026_07_29.line: Opened dashboard over Tailscale. Newish project: open terminal (build/research/general) refused with popup [open terminal refused] worktree creation failed (git-worktree-add-failed): fatal: invalid reference: HEAD. Existing effort tile: opened (project window + content). Summary quality weak.

tasks.title: Run real work in a live session and read its usage/time/cost
preconditions: T1 completed, so a project window is open.
At least one engine is available on this host.

steps: Click 'Open terminal' in the project window to start a bare general session.
Type a one-line prompt into the session terminal and press Enter.
Wait for the response to stream, then read the usage / time / cost values on the session chrome and on the dashboard tile for this project.

tasks.expected_observable: The session accepts the turn and streams a response. Every usage, time, and cost value shows either a real measured number or a NAMED state (unknown / empty / zero_measured / pending) — never a bare 0 for a value that was never aggregated, never '$0.00' presented as fact, and never '(subscription)' inferred from a zero.
failure_shapes_this_task_is_hunting: a silent zero in a usage or time tile
an empty label where the real state is unknown

john_confirmation.line: Open terminal general/Grok on Holding Company: session ran, parked-warm. Project usage now shows wall time and honest 0 tok measured / unmeasured (grok-no-claude-sidecar) rather than silent empty or no-run-sessions lie. Grok does not emit Claude sidecar tokens — named unmeasured is correct until Grok capture exists.

john_observation_2026_07_29.line: From an opened existing tile, clicked a prompt that opened a Grok window. Tokens started collecting as a Grok feedback-style interaction, not a clear project general-session turn. Project usage row showed no token count. Did not see measured usage nor a named unknown/empty/pending state on that row.

tasks.title: Stop the work, read the stop summary, and restart it
preconditions: T2 completed, so a live session exists with work in flight.

steps: Close the running session from its panel control and read the stop summary tile it leaves behind.
Count the restart controls offered in that context — there must be exactly one — and use it to restart the work.
Restart the service warm from the repository root with an elevated shell: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\restart_anchor.ps1
Reopen http://localhost:8777/ and reopen the session tile from T2.

tasks.expected_observable: The stop summary lists the work that was actually in flight (or a named unknown state if the in-flight inventory could not be read — not an empty-looking summary). The context offers exactly one restart control, which names its scope and its preserved/lost contract. After the warm restart the session reopens warm rather than cold.
failure_shapes_this_task_is_hunting: two competing restart controls in one context
a placeholder stop summary that summarizes nothing
an unreadable in-flight inventory rendered as 'nothing in flight'

john_confirmation.line: General session ended as parked-warm (retained worktree). Multiple elevated warm restarts via restart_anchor.ps1 during this session; Anchor returned HTTP 200 local and Tailscale. Exactly-one-restart-control UI not re-audited this pass; service warm restart path proven; parked session retained after stop.
